reason: A directly tests the relevant quasi-static-to-dynamic regime and proposes a physically plausible, measurable transition to phonon-drag-controlled flow, with clear rate-dependent predictions and a falsification test. B is less grounded because it assumes without evidence that Co removal increases lattice distortion and lowers stacking-fault energy, and its maximum strain rate (~10^-1 s^-1) does not probe genuinely dynamic behavior.
